name: mobile-wdio-appium-framework
description: WDIO v9 + Appium v2 + TypeScript + Mocha + Allure + Docker + Sauce Labs

scripts.docker:android:local: docker build -t wdio-appium-android-local -f docker/Dockerfile . && docker run --name wdio-android-local --rm -it -e ADB_SERVER_SOCKET=tcp:host.docker.internal:5037 -e ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT=5037 -v "$PWD":/work -v "$PWD/docker/.workdir":/work/docker/.workdir -w /work wdio-appium-android-local bash -lc "bash ./docker/run-android-local.sh"
scripts.docker:android:local:regression: docker build -t wdio-appium-android-local -f docker/Dockerfile . && docker run --name wdio-android-local --rm -it -e ADB_SERVER_SOCKET=tcp:host.docker.internal:5037 -e ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT=5037 -v "$PWD":/work -v "$PWD/docker/.workdir":/work/docker/.workdir -w /work wdio-appium-android-local bash -lc "bash ./docker/run-android-local.sh --suite regression"
scripts.docker:android:local:login-negative: docker build -t wdio-appium-android-local -f docker/Dockerfile . && docker run --name wdio-android-local --rm -it -e ADB_SERVER_SOCKET=tcp:host.docker.internal:5037 -e ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT=5037 -v "$PWD":/work -v "$PWD/docker/.workdir":/work/docker/.workdir -w /work wdio-appium-android-local bash -lc "bash ./docker/run-android-local.sh --spec ./src/tests/regression/login.negative.spec.ts"
scripts.docker:report:generate: docker build -t wdio-allure-report -f docker/Dockerfile.report . && docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work wdio-allure-report bash -lc "allure generate ./allure-results --clean -o ./reports/allure-report"
scripts.docker:report:open: docker build -t wdio-allure-report -f docker/Dockerfile.report . && docker run --rm -it -p 5050:5050 -v "$PWD":/work -w /work wdio-allure-report bash -lc "allure open -h 0.0.0.0 -p 5050 ./reports/allure-report"
